title: sync.py ship gate keeps no per-step failure output, so flaky steps (3sig lone E, 3cr, 3cx, 5b) cannot be diagnosed (ship-gate-flaky findings 2d5b6e80: nothing collides under 8-CPU load, steps slow 10-20x, suspects: 240 s must-pass cap in exec_step, 60 s defer cap, mts_signal.git 20 s TimeoutExpired uncaught, boxed(...,30) in test_codex_run.py).
